name: JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa
positioning: Seafront resort near Chania on Crete's coastline, designed by Block722 to blend into the landscape, with sea-view rooms and villas, a Cretan-inspired spa and outdoor pools
best_for: Couples and wellness travelers drawn to a spa inspired by Cretan healing rituals
Families who want a kids club and pools on a seafront resort
Travelers who want a coastal base near Chania with curated Cretan experiences

facts.text: The resort is a seafront property near Chania on Crete's coastline, spread across 100 coastal acres.
The resort is near Marathi Beach.
Accommodations offer panoramic sea views, private pools and living spaces.
The Earth-Sheltered Villa has two bedrooms and a separate living area.
Anoseas Spa has an exclusive couple's suite, a steam bath and a KLAFS sauna.
The resort has three outdoor pools: an adult pool, a main pool and a kids pool.
The main pool is surrounded by sweeping sea views.
Movement options range from sunrise yoga with sea views on the wooden deck to guided hikes along the surrounding hills.
The Phaistos Den kids club invites younger guests to explore, create and play, inspired by Cretan culture and nature.
Onalos is a beachfront seafood restaurant with a sea-to-table concept and Aegean flavors.
The JW Garden grows local herbs used to flavor the restaurant and bar menus.
Local experiences include hiking and wine or olive oil tasting.

highlights.text: The resort was designed by Athens-based studio Block722, with green rooftops, olive and carob trees, and natural materials such as marble and wood that blend it into the landscape.
Anoseas Spa is inspired by traditional Cretan healing rituals, enhanced with modern, immersive therapies.
The spa is complemented by a sunlit yoga deck overlooking the sea and an indoor vitality pool.
A boat trip takes guests to Balos and Gramvousa, an area protected by the Natura 2000 program.
A custom-designed parkour trail invites playful fitness, and personal trainers create tailored programs.

considerations.text: The resort operates seasonally and closes for part of the year, so check opening dates when planning.
The resort is secluded, set near Chania rather than in the town, with the airport and port nearby.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
